snippet.title: eFootball Kick-Off! – Nintendo Direct: Partner Showcase 2.5.2026
snippet.description:
eFootball Kick-Off! is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in summer 2026.

Take to the field your way.

Build your dream soccer club and compete worldwide in “World Tour” mode! Win matches to acquire new players or use Coins earned through matches to sign legendary players.

In the “International Cup” mode, feel the excitement of soccer’s ultimate festival, held every four years, as national teams battle for global supremacy.

Or, enjoy beginner-friendly modes like 6-a-side soccer that creates plenty of goal-scoring opportunities, and the Rank system, where your performance is evaluated and allows you to step up as you improve.

Experience the passion and excitement of soccer, anytime, anywhere—solo or with friends, offline or online.
 
#eFootballKickOff #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoDirect

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
